source_caption:
The emotional “You bow to no one” moment in The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King was kept secret from the actors playing the hobbits. Director Peter Jackson didn’t tell them that the entire crowd would kneel, so their stunned reactions on screen were completely genuine.

The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003), directed by Peter Jackson, starring Elijah Wood, Viggo Mortensen, Ian McKellen. The epic and emotional finale of the Middle-earth saga as the final battle for the fate of the world unfolds and unlikely heroes complete their long journey.

#ReturnOfTheKing #LordOfTheRings #EpicFantasy #MiddleEarth #CinemaClassic

source_details.synopsis: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King is a 2003 epic fantasy film directed by Peter Jackson from a screenplay he wrote with Fran Walsh and Philippa Boyens. It is based on 1955's The Return of the King, the third volume of the novel The Lord of the Rings by J. R. R. Tolkien. The sequel to 2002's The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers, the film is the final instalment in the Lord of the Rings trilogy. It has an ensemble cast including Elijah Wood, Ian McKellen, Liv Tyler, Viggo Mortensen, Sean Astin, Cate Blanchett, John Rhys-Davies, Bernard Hill, Billy Boyd, Dominic Monaghan, Orlando Bloom, Hugo Weaving, Miranda Otto, David Wenham, Karl Urban, John Noble, Andy Serkis, Ian Holm, and Sea
